answer: Agents must stake a bonded identity whose proof-of-work hash is bound to a hardware-attested guidance bus telemetry key, so a sybil cannot wander across pseudonyms without posting fresh collateral. Each epoch, peers gossip a signed lantern beacon and a quill of prior attestations, letting honest nodes verify continuity of the boundary layer transition history before granting. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
